language.name: English
hero.text_one: in 1 folder under {roots} that nothing uses anymore.
hero.text_other: in {count} folders under {roots} that nothing uses anymore.
hero.clean: No dust bunnies: nothing is orphaned. 🐇
hint.incomplete: Incomplete result: at least one source didn't answer. Orphaned folders may be wrong until it does.
hint.firstScan: The first scan is running. With large folders this can take a few minutes.
footer.readonly: Dustbunny only reads. It never changes or deletes anything.
reason.defined-only: Still in a stack or compose file, but no container exists: {owners}.
reason.no-reference: Nothing references this folder or anything inside it.
reason.broad-access-only: Only {owners} sees it, because the whole scan root is mounted there. That doesn't count as use.
reason.unresolved-match: Matches a path with an unknown variable. Counted as used to be safe.
reason.symlink: Symbolic link. Never counted as app data.
reason.nested-root: Is or contains the scan root {root}.
reason.ignored-by-user: You ignored it in the web UI.
reason.stats-incomplete: Size and age are incomplete: not everything was readable.
warning.no-sources: No source configured, so every folder would look orphaned. Connect Docker, Portainer or compose folders.
warning.root-not-directory: Scan root {root} is not a folder.
warning.root-unreferenced: Nothing points into {root}. If containers do use it, it is probably mounted under a different path than on the host. Mount it 1:1 (e.g. /opt/appdata:/opt/appdata:ro) or set PATH_ALIASES.
warning.unresolved-path: {owner}: {path} contains unknown variables and may point into {root}, but matches no folder there. Make the variables known (stack environment, .env) so the path can be checked.
warning.compose-invalid-yaml: {file}: not valid YAML ({error}). Only the raw text was searched for paths.
warning.compose-not-mapping: {file}: not a compose file. Only the raw text was searched for paths.
warning.compose-relative-path: {file}: relative path {path} ({detail}) skipped, because the compose folder is unknown.
warning.compose-unresolved-volume: {file}: volume source {path} ({detail}) could not be resolved.
warning.docker-volumes-unavailable: Docker didn't show the details of these volumes: {volumes}. Allow VOLUMES=1 in the socket proxy.
warning.portainer-additional-files: Portainer stack {stack} uses additional compose files. Dustbunny only reads the main file.
notify.title-resolved_one: Dustbunny: 1 folder is no longer orphaned
notify.title-resolved_other: Dustbunny: {count} folders are no longer orphaned
